The '''''G'mi Moa''''' was a [[Lianna/Legends|Liannan]] [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighter]], which traveled a regular shipping route along the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]. At one point along its usual routine, the ship was boarded and hijacked by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Gunda Mabin/Legends|Gunda Mabin]].
